audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the names and descriptions for hats 80–99. Both mirrored display-name fields were kept identical; all flags, sprite indices, empty fields and slash structure were preserved exactly. Hat 92 intentionally retains its hidden question-mark label and description.
